topbar.tagMap.tip: Manage how auto-tagged English tags are written back as your library's own tags
tagmap.title: Tag mapping
tagmap.searchPlaceholder: Search English tag or your label
tagmap.hint: Mapping only applies when auto-tagging writes back: matched English tags become your labels, others stay English. Click Save to persist. Clearing a row disables that mapping.
tagmap.confirmClose: You have unsaved changes. Close anyway?
tagmap.needBoth: Both the English tag and your label are required
tagmap.suggestEmpty: No matching tag — you can type the English tag directly
tagmap.noMatch: No Danbooru tag found for "{q}" — pick one from the list
tagmap.onlyFirstN: Showing first {n} — type more to narrow down
tagmap.noSuggest: No new suggestions (already mapped tags are skipped)
tagmap.syncNoRename: Rescanned {n} local tags, no renames found
tagmap.syncPartial: {removed} local tag(s) gone, {added} new — tag list refreshed; check mappings for stale entries
tagmap.syncSuspect: Library scan came back empty (Eagle may still be loading) — sync cancelled, try again later
tagger.onlyMapped: Skip unmatched tags (write local tags only)
tagger.onlyMapped.hint: When checked, English tags that do not map to one of your own tags are dropped; only mapped tags get written.
tagger.mapStats: Available mappings: {auto} auto + {manual} manual (edit in Tag map)
